business_summary: ABM Knowledgeware Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides e-governance information security, technology-enabled applications through cloud services, and other software services in India. It also provides cloud-based security-as-a-service solutions that enable mobile and remote workforces to securely access corporate applications, email, and web resources from any device, over any network, and from any location. ABM Knowledgeware Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Mumbai, India.
